title: WanVideoWorkflowConfig
description: Configuration contract for populating Wan 2.1 video diffusion workflows in ComfyUI.

prompt.description: 4-part kinetic motion prompt describing subject action, interaction, physics, and camera path.

negative_prompt.default: blurry, low quality, distorted anatomy, jitter, artifacts, static, strobe, slideshow

reference_image_path.description: Local path or URI to approved storyboard keyframe image for Image-to-Video conditioning.
